en.answer: In the proposed scenario, since a monster card left the field and was sent to the Graveyard, the effect of <<12001>> can be applied and a Spell Counter is placed on it.
en.question: If a <<11977>> treated as an Equip Card by its own effect leaves the field, can the effect of <<12001>> to place Spell Counter on itself be applied?
